svg.title: Ficção científica
svg.desc: A small elegant vintage astronomical armillary sphere in muted sage patinated metal resting on two ivory books, restrained scientific fiction, no neon.
svg.metadata: {"id": "ficcao-cientifica", "titulo": "Ficção científica", "descricao": "A small elegant vintage astronomical armillary sphere in muted sage patinated metal resting on two ivory books, restrained scientific fiction, no neon.", "tipo": "hibrido-png-incorporado", "viewBox": "0 0 1254 1254", "paleta": {"papel": "#F7F5EC", "branco": "#FFFFFF", "floresta": "#254D3D", "salvia": "#9AAE99", "nevoa": "#E6ECE2", "oliva": "#7C8767"}, "arquivo": "01_ilustracoes/ficcao-cientifica.svg", "repetivel": false, "resolucao_raster": [1254, 1254], "fundo": "papel claro opaco", "prompt": "Create one finished square editorial watercolor illustration for a premium reading and writing app. Subject: A small elegant vintage astronomical armillary sphere in muted sage patinated metal resting on two ivory books, restrained scientific fiction, no neon. Style: refined naturalistic handmade watercolor and dry brush on cold-pressed paper, pigment granulation, restrained delicate detail, organic uneven edges, understated mature design like traditional book arts. Palette strictly ivory #F7F5EC, sage #9AAE99, dark forest green #254D3D, muted olive accents. Composition one cohesive isolated vignette centered occupying 75% of canvas, generous clean margin, plain warm ivory background #F7F5EC. No black background, no lettering, no logos, no text, no cartoon, no 3D, no glossy effects, no ornamental clutter. Fine nuanced brushwork.
